mapper.insert: INSERT INTO car_goal ( user_id, budget, car_type_code, is_new, experience_years, target_date, region, status, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{budget}, #{carTypeCode}, #{isNew}, #{experienceYears}, #{targetDate}, #{region}, 'DRAFT', NOW(), #{userId}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM car_model WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT * FROM car_model WHERE del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY car_type_code ASC, base_price ASC
SELECT * FROM car_tax WHERE car_type_code = #{carTypeCode} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT * FROM car_ev WHERE region = #{region} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY base_year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM car_tax_prepay WHERE year = #{year} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY discount_rate DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: g.goal_id, g.budget, g.car_type_code, g.is_new, g.experience_years, g.target_date, g.region, g.selected_model_id, m.model_name AS selectedModelName, g.selected_year, g.status
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM car_goal g LEFT JOIN car_model m ON g.selected_model_id = m.model_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY g.created_date DESC
